description: This file defines a BookingService class responsible for managing booking data and notifying UI components of changes.

classes.name: BookingService
classes.description: A service class that manages bookings, allowing addition of new bookings and providing a list of existing bookings.

methods.name: addBooking
methods.description: Creates a new Booking instance with provided event, seat list, and total price, then adds it to the internal bookings list and notifies listeners.
